verdict.rationale: CAM runs and documents its own incubator, Prarambh, which gives startups structured access through a 12-stage programme and a 10-week cohort, with mentorship, access to the firm's lawyers, beta-testing help and investor exposure. Its scope is narrow: it is legaltech-only, and the eligibility rule of at least one year in existence limits access for very early startups. missing for 10: programs open to non-legaltech founders, documented partnerships with external accelerators or university ecosystems, access for pre-registration or under-one-year startups, independent corroboration of program outcomes.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents programs or partnerships with accelerators, incubators, or university ecosystems that give early startups structured access

citations.quote: Prarambh is India's first Legaltech incubator launched by cam in February 2019, with the aim of nurturing young entrepreneurs
every startup that becomes part of the Prarambh ecosystem goes through a 12-stage programme that offers end-to-end solutions
the selected innovator companies will be provided mentorship, counselling and guidance by the Prarambh team
The duration of the cohort will be 10 weeks which may be extended at the discretion of the firm
